name: Beexen
source:
Beexen is a major antagonist of The Beexen's Tales, Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change' DLC.
Born as a heir of Beelivers' (a race, resembling anthropomorphic bees) royal family, Beexen was born as a "drone" - a Beeliver, unable to childbirth, losing any chances to become the next monarch of her kind.
Eventually a mysterious Eldritch being known as Tai-Anahra lured Beexen on his side for his quest to take over Beexen's homeworld.
Stopping a corrupted Beeliver princess is a main goal of a player in The Beexen's Tales.
